note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 2 June 1949. Nominations closed on Tuesday 17 May 1949: the twenty sitting members of twenty divisions were nominated again, and only Ballyclug was contested; no nomination was received for Cloughogue, Glenravel and Drumanaway, where the sitting members were expected to be deemed re-elected (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 20 May 1949, p. 6; Ballymena Observer, 20 May 1949, p. 8). Sole nominee, a sitting member, returned unopposed: named in the list of nominees for the uncontested divisions (Ballymena Weekly Telegraph, 20 May 1949, p. 6). Returned unopposed.
